{{Weapon infobox | type = Staff | level = 80 | salvage = none | bound = account use | skin = The Bifrost (skin); The Legend (skin); Imryldyeen (skin); The Legend Experiment (skin) | rarity = legendary | prefix = selectable | uslot = Superior Sigil of Nullification | id = 30698 | gallery2 = The Bifrost detail.jpg | gallery2-text = Detail of the head of the staff. }} [[The Bifrost]] is a [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] staff crafted in the [[Mystic Forge]]. == Lore == {{Legendary unlock text|Casters and archivists alike worship the iridescent glow that the Bifrost emits. Although the source of its magic is unknown, its luminous aura may hint of realms bygone—tucked away in [[the Mists]].}} == Acquisition == === Contained in === {{contained in}} === Recipe === {{recipe | source = Mystic Forge | quantity = 1 | ingredient1 = 1 The Legend | ingredient2 = 1 Gift of The Bifrost | ingredient3 = 1 Gift of Fortune | ingredient4 = 1 Gift of Mastery }} == Graphics == The Bifrost is a rainbow staff surrounded by an ever glowing rainbow aura, and has crystalline shapes floating around the tip. ;Aura * The user's body is surrounded by rainbows. ;Draw effects * Upon drawing the weapon the user is surrounded by rainbow light that then reduces to the held light aura. Additionally when drawn an echo-like audio is heard. ;Footfalls * The user leaves behind rainbow footprints, as well as small rainbows every few steps. ;Skill effects * Default projectiles are replaced with a small ball of white light surrounded by a rainbow aura, which also leaves a rainbow trail in its path. This effect changes the following skills: **{{g}} [[Guardian]]: {{Skill icon|Bolt of Wrath}}, {{Skill icon|Searing Light}}, and {{Skill icon|Seeking Judgment}}. ***{{dragonhunter}} [[Dragonhunter]]: {{Skill icon|Spear of Justice}}. **{{re}} [[Revenant]]: {{Skill icon|Essence Sap}} (downed skill), and {{Skill icon|Rejuvenating Assault}}'s whirl finishers. ***{{renegade}} [[Renegade]]: {{Skill icon|Citadel Bombardment}}. **{{druid}} [[Druid]]: {{Skill icon|Astral Wisp}}, projectiles that pass through {{Skill icon|Sublime Conversion}}, and {{Skill icon|Throw Dirt}} (downed skill). **{{daredevil}} [[Daredevil]]: Projectiles acquired through {{Skill icon|Steal}}, and {{Skill icon|Trail of Knives}} (downed skill). **{{n}} [[Necromancer]]: {{Skill icon|Dhuumfire (death shroud skill)|Dhuumfire}}, {{Skill icon|Dark Path}}, {{Skill icon|Life Blast}} and {{Skill icon|Necrotic Grasp}}. ***{{harbinger}} [[Harbinger]]: {{Skill icon|Dark Barrage}}, {{Skill icon|Tainted Bolts}}. **{{e}} [[Elementalist]]: {{Skill icon|Chain Lightning}}, {{Skill icon|Fireball}}, {{Skill icon|Gust}}, {{Skill icon|Shockwave}}, {{Skill icon|Stoning}}, and {{Skill icon|Water Blast}}. ***{{tempest}} [[Tempest]]: the first whirl finisher of {{Skill icon|Overload Fire}}, but not subsequent ones. ***{{weaver}} [[Weaver]]: {{Skill icon|Monsoon (weaver skill)|Monsoon}}, {{Skill icon|Plasma Blast}}, {{Skill icon|Pressure Blast}}, and {{Skill icon|Pyroclastic Blast}}. **{{m}} [[Mesmer]]: {{Skill icon|Winds of Chaos}}. ***{{virtuoso}} [[Virtuoso]]: {{Skill icon|Bladesong Dissonance}}, {{Skill icon|Bladesong Harmony}}, {{Skill icon|Bladesong Sorrow}}. === Gallery === The Bifrost concept art.jpg|Concept art by [[Kekai Kotaki]]. == Available prefixes == * The following [[Attribute combinations|prefixes]] can be selected: {{prefix selection|all legendary}} == Trivia == * In Norse mythology, [[w:Bifröst|Bifröst]] is the rainbow bridge connecting Midgård (World of Men) to Asgård (World of the Gods). Although the etymology is unclear, the components of the word are ''bif'' and ''röst'', not ''bi-'' and ''frost'' as is often assumed. * [[Zommoros]] can be seen wielding '''The Bifrost''' alongside [[The Shining Blade]] while fighting [[Qadim]] in the [[Mythwright Gambit]] raid wing. == See also == * [[The Bifrost I: The Experimental Staff]] * [[The Bifrost II: The Perfected Staff]] * [[The Bifrost III: The Legend]] {{Legendary weapon nav}} [[Category:Legendary weapons|B]] [[de:Der Bifröst]] [[es:El Bifrost]] [[fr:Le Bifrost]]
